question: The Contact Process is used for the manufacturing of which of the following chemicals?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sulphuric acid**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Contact Process** is an industrial method used for the manufacturing of **sulphuric acid**, one of the most widely used chemicals in the world.
 
• It involves the catalytic oxidation of **sulphur dioxide (SO₂)** to **sulphur trioxide (SO₃)** using a **vanadium pentoxide (V₂O₅)** catalyst.
 
• The process consists of three main steps:
 
 
• Production of **sulphur dioxide** by burning sulphur or roasting sulphide ores.
 
• Conversion of sulphur dioxide to **sulphur trioxide** in the presence of a catalyst.
 
• Absorption of sulphur trioxide in **concentrated sulphuric acid** to form oleum, which is then diluted to produce sulphuric acid.
 
 
 
• **Sulphuric acid** is a highly versatile chemical used in various industries, including the manufacture of fertilizers, chemicals, petroleum refining, and wastewater treatment.
 
• The Contact Process is preferred over older methods such as the **Lead Chamber Process** due to its higher efficiency and production of purer sulphuric acid.
 
• The chemical equation for the key step in the process is: **2SO₂ + O₂ → 2SO₃** (in the presence of a catalyst).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ammonia**__

 __
 
• **Ammonia** is manufactured using the **Haber Process**, not the Contact Process.
 
• It is a key ingredient in the production of **fertilizers** such as urea and ammonium nitrate.
 
• The Haber Process involves the reaction of **nitrogen (N₂)** and **hydrogen (H₂)** gases under high pressure and temperature, using an iron catalyst.
 
 
 
• **Nitric acid**__
 __
 
• **Nitric acid** is manufactured using the **Ostwald Process**, not the Contact Process.
 
• The Ostwald Process involves the oxidation of **ammonia** to produce nitric acid.
 
• Nitric acid is widely used in the production of **explosives, fertilizers**, and other chemicals.
 
 
 
• **Hydrochloric acid**__
 
 
• **Hydrochloric acid** is typically produced as a byproduct of industrial processes, such as the manufacture of **chlorine** or **polyvinyl chloride (PVC)**.
 
• It is used in a variety of applications, including **metal cleaning, pH control, and production of organic compounds**.
